statement: The active MP downstream-connected bit signals an attached child behind the active unit, not the count of MP units or active gyros. Its frame discriminator separates gyro samples from a child frame; mode 04 is gyro-only and modes 05/07 multiplex Nunchuk/Classic-family child layouts with repacked fields. A true child bit alone cannot identify a second MP or prove independent sampling.
